kcie01.title: Virgo, voice note, take four
kcie01.caption: Four takes, one handwritten script, one neighbour's dog, and the final answer was a text. Fourteen minutes well spent. Who else rehearses a voice note like it's a speech?

kcie02.title: Gemini typed LMAO with a straight face
kcie02.caption: Laughed out loud on the bus for the crush's cat story. Typed LMAOOOO for the friend's fog joke with a perfectly blank face. Which friend gets your real laugh?

kcie03.title: Leo checked their reflection mid-date
kcie03.caption: The window, the spoon, the phone screen: three reflection checks before the story about the dog even ended. Then the date pulled out a pocket mirror. Match made?

kcie04.title: Cancer saved a 'gn' screenshot
kcie04.caption: One 'gn :)' got zoomed to 400%, archived, printed and framed on the wall. The folder is at 48 now. What's the most screenshotted text on your phone?

kcie05.title: Aries replied in 0.3 seconds
kcie05.caption: The phone buzzed and Aries cleared the couch in one dive. The play-it-cool timer lasted nine seconds. Then they replied just as fast. Fast texter or slow texter?

kcie06.title: Taurus said 'on my way' from bed
kcie06.caption: 'On my way!!' sent from under a blanket. Leaving in 5, then 10, then 15. Then the friend sent a photo from their own bed. Who in your group texts it first?

kcie07.title: The Libra committee answers 'hey'
kcie07.caption: Four drafts, one whiteboard, a vote, a recount and a tearful Pisces tie-break. Two hours later, the 'hey' was meant for someone else. Who's on your reply committee?

kcie08.title: Sagittarius planned the trip after one chat
kcie08.caption: Ten minutes of talking at a party and there was already a map, an itinerary and matching luggage. Day one: learn their name. Who plans the whole trip after one good chat?

kcie09.title: Capricorn scheduled a feelings slot
kcie09.caption: A calendar block that says FEEL FEELINGS, 3:00 to 3:15. At 3:00 it was everything at once. By 3:16 the meeting was extended indefinitely. Who else books time to have a crush?

kcie10.title: Aquarius took a fake call in aisle five
kcie10.caption: The ex appeared at the end of the cereal aisle, so Aquarius called the space station. Then the phone actually rang. The wave back was with a melon. What's your ex-sighting move?

kcie11.title: Pisces cried at their own birthday text
kcie11.caption: Pisces wrote a birthday text, cried, edited it, cried more, then read it out to the plant. The friend replied 'I'M CRYING'. Who's the friend that makes you cry on your birthday?

kcie12.title: Scorpio is still mad about 2019
kcie12.caption: Smiling at the party while the 2019 file sits open: 'didn't laugh at my joke'. Turns out they were just nervous. One file closed, plenty more in the cabinet. What year is your grudge from?

kcie13.title: Sagittarius swore off dating (on Saturday)
kcie13.caption: Saturday brunch: a toast, a banner, a FREE ERA sash. Saturday night: one little reply. Sunday: a date, sash still on. Nineteen hours. How long did your last era last?

kcie14.title: Taurus stayed dressed for cancelled plans
kcie14.caption: Three outfits, the good shoes, then 'can we do next week?' So Taurus cooked dinner in the outfit and took a selfie with the plant. Do you change or stay dressed?

kcie15.title: Aquarius explained lighthouses for forty minutes
kcie15.caption: 'So what are you into?' Forty minutes and three napkin diagrams later, the date leaned in and asked how the lens works. Then pulled out a napkin of their own. What would your forty-minute topic be?

kcie16.title: Aries, caught five times before bedtime
kcie16.caption: Six snoozes, an argument with a parking meter, a trench paced into a cafe floor and a text in all caps. Catch number five is the one Aries is proud of. Which catch is most you?

kcie17.title: Cancer, a whole day caught in 4K
kcie17.caption: Hugged the delivery driver, reread a two-year-old chat 'for research', cooked dinner for six for one. Then a friend showed up with soup, and this time it was for Cancer. Who brings you the soup?

kcie18.title: Libra, caught deciding all day
kcie18.caption: Twenty minutes on two identical sweaters. 'Anywhere!' then 'not there.' Agreeing with both sides of a fight. Then one question that took Libra no time at all. What's the one thing you never overthink?

kcie19.title: Scorpio, five catches in one day
kcie19.caption: Sunglasses indoors, a heartfelt paragraph replaced by 'k', mouthing every word of a song they've 'never heard'. Then movie night with Pisces, and the sunglasses go back on for a reason. Mysterious or soft?

kcie20.title: Capricorn, caught off-schedule
kcie20.caption: A spreadsheet on the morning run, a five-year plan for a houseplant, a reply in bullet points. Then 'one more walk?' at 8:52, and the planner went flying. What's the best thing you never planned?
